kind: Controlled component/media event integration and real MP3 decoding; not browser sound-output verification

checks.name: MP3 decodes and duration matches the timeline
15 chronological cues preserve the seven approved phrases and all repetitions
Starts real play operation synchronously from the user action; no autoplay on mount
Media time drives highlights and repeat counter; tapping a line seeks the recording
Pause, scrub, next/previous and replay use the audio clock
Closing pauses audio and ignores completion of an older play promise
Autoplay denial shows a recoverable message and retries on click
Arabic words and supplied Arabic explanation remain verbatim; English translation accompanies each line
Missing or rejected phrase blocks playback instead of inventing content
